reasoning: The icon depicts a circle below a single curved arc band, which is a UI status glyph for a weak (1-bar) Wi-Fi signal. While it works for tasks about Wi-Fi networks or fixing weak wireless coverage, a standard three-bar Wi-Fi icon is much more recognizable and less likely to look like an abstract geometric shape.
